say:2:1720824002:1.text: Or should I call you by the alias you used undercover? Or perhaps some other name I've yet to learn?
say:2:1720824002:1.source_cn: 还是说，我该称呼你卧底时的假名？又或是什么我尚不知道的...

say:4:1720824004:1.text: What is it? Disappointed to see me?
say:4:1720824004:1.source_cn: 怎么，你就这么不想见到我？

say:5:1720824005:0.text: Not at all. It's an honor.
say:5:1720824005:0.source_cn: 当然不是，见到您是我的荣幸。

say:6:1720824006:1.text: Though I could've sworn I arranged to meet with your lady in waiting, Ansia, not yourself.
say:6:1720824006:1.source_cn: 只是我依稀记得，我是和您的侍女安塞女士约定见面，而不是...

say:7:1720824007:0.text: I know. You intended to pass an engagement gift to her and have her deliver it, yes?
say:7:1720824007:0.source_cn: 我知道，你是要送庆祝订婚的礼物，让安塞转交给我，对吧？

say:8:1720824008:0.text: I thought that unnecessary, so I granted her the day off and chose to receive you myself.
say:8:1720824008:0.source_cn: 我认为不需要那么麻烦，所以就给安塞放假，亲自过来了。

say:9:1720824009:1.text: After all, a gift is most meaningful when given face to face... Or could it be that you're not actually offering your sincere congratulations, Sir Valen?
say:9:1720824009:1.source_cn: 毕竟礼物还是要当面送才最有诚意。还是说，维伦先生其实并...

say:10:1720824010:0.text: You wound me. I was trying to spare you the trouble. It's a modest gift; I'd hate to waste your time over it.
say:10:1720824010:0.source_cn: 怎么会呢，您误解了。只是这件礼物太过普通，实在不愿因它...

say:11:1720824011:0.text: Is that so? And yet you arrive accompanied by Magister Merlin himself.
say:11:1720824011:0.source_cn: 是吗？我倒不这么觉得。普通的礼物，能劳烦梅林阁下亲自来送？
say:11:1720824011:0.male: Is that so? And yet you arrive accompanied by Magister Merlin himself.
say:11:1720824011:0.female: Is that so? And yet you arrive accompanied by Magister Merlin herself.

say:12:1720824012:1.text: Magister, I am Charlotte Jonson. It's a pleasure. My father speaks of you often. He holds you in the highest regard and calls you a truly exceptional mage.
say:12:1720824012:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我是夏洛蒂·琼森。很荣幸能够见到您，父亲最近...
say:12:1720824012:1.male: Magister, I am Charlotte Jonson. It's a pleasure. My father speaks of you often. He holds you in the highest regard and calls you a truly exceptional mage.
say:12:1720824012:1.female: Magister, I am Charlotte Jonson. It's a pleasure. My father speaks of you often. He holds you in the highest regard and calls you a truly exceptional mage.

say:13:1720824013:0.text: Forgive me, but might I ask why you've come with him to deliver this gift?
say:13:1720824013:0.source_cn: 恕我冒昧，请问您为什么会和他一起来送这份礼物呢？
say:13:1720824013:0.male: Forgive me, but might I ask why you've come with him to deliver this gift?
say:13:1720824013:0.female: Forgive me, but might I ask why you've come with him to deliver this gift?

choice_prompt:14:1720824013.male: Forgive me, but might I ask why you've come with him to deliver this gift?
choice_prompt:14:1720824013.female: Forgive me, but might I ask why you've come with him to deliver this gift?

say:15:1720824014:1.text: Sensing the tension, you explain the situation concisely, careful not to reveal anything about the Solitaries.
say:15:1720824014:1.source_cn: 感受到气氛的僵硬，你尽量简洁地、以不暴露隐士的方式讲述...
say:15:1720824014:1.male: Sensing the tension, you explain the situation concisely, careful not to reveal anything about the Solitaries.
say:15:1720824014:1.female: Sensing the tension, you explain the situation concisely, careful not to reveal anything about the Solitaries.

say:16:1720824015:1.text: You agreed to deliver the gift as part of a deal. In return, you would learn about Valen's past.
say:16:1720824015:1.source_cn: 你之所以帮忙来送订婚礼物，是因为这是一桩交易——完成交...
say:16:1720824015:1.male: You agreed to deliver the gift as part of a deal. In return, you would learn about Valen's past.
say:16:1720824015:1.female: You agreed to deliver the gift as part of a deal. In return, you would learn about Valen's past.

say:17:1720824016:0.text: A deal? Hm, that does sound familiar.
say:17:1720824016:0.male: A deal? Hm, that does sound familiar.
say:17:1720824016:0.female: A deal? Hm, that does sound familiar.

say:18:1720824017:0.text: You wish to learn of his past? As it happens, I know a fragment or two of it.
say:18:1720824017:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下是想了解维伦的过去？正巧，我知道一些。
say:18:1720824017:0.male: You wish to learn of his past? As it happens, I know a fragment or two of it.
say:18:1720824017:0.female: You wish to learn of his past? As it happens, I know a fragment or two of it.

say:19:1720824018:0.text: I'll share what I know. Consider it my thanks. You don't mind, do you, Valen?
say:19:1720824018:0.source_cn: 为表感谢，我会把我知道的告诉您。维伦，你没有意见吧？

say:21:1720824020:0.text: Very well. This was three years ago...
say:21:1720824020:0.male: Very well. This was three years ago...
say:21:1720824020:0.female: Very well. This was three years ago...

say:24:1720824021:0.text:
My family's always been in the ore business, and we control an iron mine. It's not large, but it's reliable.
But three years ago, things went wrong.
say:24:1720824021:0.source_cn: 我们家一直在做矿石生意，掌握着一处铁矿区。虽然不大，但...
say:24:1720824021:0.male:
My family's always been in the ore business, and we control an iron mine. It's not large, but it's reliable.
But three years ago, things went wrong.
say:24:1720824021:0.female:
My family's always been in the ore business, and we control an iron mine. It's not large, but it's reliable.
But three years ago, things went wrong.

say:25:1720824022:0.text: A batch of military iron was found to be substandard. No accidents happened, but the damage to our reputation was severe.
say:25:1720824022:0.source_cn: 一批军需的铁材被检验出质量不合格，虽然尚未造成事故，但...
say:25:1720824022:0.male: A batch of military iron was found to be substandard. No accidents happened, but the damage to our reputation was severe.
say:25:1720824022:0.female: A batch of military iron was found to be substandard. No accidents happened, but the damage to our reputation was severe.

say:26:1720824023:0.text: The troubling part was this: we had no knowledge of any defect. Even after a thorough review of the entire mining process, no irregularities could be found.
say:26:1720824023:0.source_cn: 问题在于，我们对劣质铁材的事毫不知情。就算重新追溯了整...
say:26:1720824023:0.male: The troubling part was this: we had no knowledge of any defect. Even after a thorough review of the entire mining process, no irregularities could be found.
say:26:1720824023:0.female: The troubling part was this: we had no knowledge of any defect. Even after a thorough review of the entire mining process, no irregularities could be found.

say:27:1720824024:0.text: It became clear someone was targeting our family, and we were facing accusations of passing off inferior goods to the military. My father was consumed with worry.
say:27:1720824024:0.source_cn: 我们家被一个藏在暗处、不怀好意的人盯上了，还面临着以次...
say:27:1720824024:0.male: It became clear someone was targeting our family, and we were facing accusations of passing off inferior goods to the military. My father was consumed with worry.
say:27:1720824024:0.female: It became clear someone was targeting our family, and we were facing accusations of passing off inferior goods to the military. My father was consumed with worry.

say:28:1720824025:0.text: Until one day, he invited a guest. A young man who claimed to be a viscount overseeing military supply inspections.
say:28:1720824025:0.source_cn: 直到一天，他突然邀请了一位陌生的客人做客。那人是个名声...
say:28:1720824025:0.male: Until one day, he invited a guest. A young man who claimed to be a viscount overseeing military supply inspections.
say:28:1720824025:0.female: Until one day, he invited a guest. A young man who claimed to be a viscount overseeing military supply inspections.

say:29:1720824026:0.text: He was only about my age, but my father treated him with unusual caution and respect.
say:29:1720824026:0.source_cn: 他只是个与我年纪相仿的年轻人，但父亲对他的态度却审慎又...
say:29:1720824026:0.male: He was only about my age, but my father treated him with unusual caution and respect.
say:29:1720824026:0.female: He was only about my age, but my father treated him with unusual caution and respect.

say:30:1720824027:0.text: From that point on, he became a frequent presence in our household. Private discussions with my father, appearances at social functions...
say:30:1720824027:0.source_cn: 从那开始，他开始频繁出入琼森府邸，常常与父亲密谈，还受...
say:30:1720824027:0.male: From that point on, he became a frequent presence in our household. Private discussions with my father, appearances at social functions...
say:30:1720824027:0.female: From that point on, he became a frequent presence in our household. Private discussions with my father, appearances at social functions...

say:31:1720824028:0.text: To outsiders, he seemed very close to our family. My friends even started asking if my father had chosen my future husband.
say:31:1720824028:0.source_cn: 外人来看，他与我家关系极为亲密。我的朋友们甚至都开始悄...
say:31:1720824028:0.male: To outsiders, he seemed very close to our family. My friends even started asking if my father had chosen my future husband.
say:31:1720824028:0.female: To outsiders, he seemed very close to our family. My friends even started asking if my father had chosen my future husband.

say:32:1720824029:0.text: I thought my father was trying to solve our problems through marriage. I wasn't pleased... but I understood.
say:32:1720824029:0.source_cn: 我那时认为，父亲是想要通过联姻解决家族的困难。虽然心有...
say:32:1720824029:0.male: I thought my father was trying to solve our problems through marriage. I wasn't pleased... but I understood.
say:32:1720824029:0.female: I thought my father was trying to solve our problems through marriage. I wasn't pleased... but I understood.

say:33:1720824030:0.text: When he arranged for us to spend time together, I didn't refuse. And over time, I came to think he was... not a bad sort.
say:33:1720824030:0.source_cn: 父亲再安排我与这位子爵接触时，我没有拒绝。接触下来，我...
say:33:1720824030:0.male: When he arranged for us to spend time together, I didn't refuse. And over time, I came to think he was... not a bad sort.
say:33:1720824030:0.female: When he arranged for us to spend time together, I didn't refuse. And over time, I came to think he was... not a bad sort.

say:34:1720824031:0.text: So I told them I was willing to accept the engagement. Only to discover that it had all been a fabrication.
say:34:1720824031:0.source_cn: 所以，我主动向父亲和这位子爵提出，我愿意订婚。结果……...
say:34:1720824031:0.male: So I told them I was willing to accept the engagement. Only to discover that it had all been a fabrication.
say:34:1720824031:0.female: So I told them I was willing to accept the engagement. Only to discover that it had all been a fabrication.

say:35:1720824032:0.text: He wasn't a viscount at all. He was a member of the Heroic Order, dispatched to investigate those who sought to undermine us.
say:35:1720824032:0.source_cn: 这人不是子爵，而是骑士团的人。从一开始，他就是来调查那...
say:35:1720824032:0.male: He wasn't a viscount at all. He was a member of the Heroic Order, dispatched to investigate those who sought to undermine us.
say:35:1720824032:0.female: He wasn't a viscount at all. He was a member of the Heroic Order, dispatched to investigate those who sought to undermine us.

say:36:1720824033:0.text: Using a false identity and cultivating an appearance of closeness with my family... all of it was part of his undercover mission.
say:36:1720824033:0.source_cn: 使用假身份、向外界刻意营造自己与琼森家的亲密关系，都是...
say:36:1720824033:0.male: Using a false identity and cultivating an appearance of closeness with my family... all of it was part of his undercover mission.
say:36:1720824033:0.female: Using a false identity and cultivating an appearance of closeness with my family... all of it was part of his undercover mission.

say:37:1720824034:0.text: My father, of course, knew the truth. He simply chose not to share it with me, wishing to shield me from the risks involved. And that's how the engagement fiasco came about.
say:37:1720824034:0.source_cn: 父亲一直配合他的工作，但担心我知道实情会暴露，招惹风险...
say:37:1720824034:0.male: My father, of course, knew the truth. He simply chose not to share it with me, wishing to shield me from the risks involved. And that's how the engagement fiasco came about.
say:37:1720824034:0.female: My father, of course, knew the truth. He simply chose not to share it with me, wishing to shield me from the risks involved. And that's how the engagement fiasco came about.

say:39:1720824035:0.source_cn: 我说的没错吧，尊敬的维伦“子爵”？

say:41:1720824036:0.text: As expected of the ever-perceptive Lady Charlotte. Your memory for detail is... quite something.
say:41:1720824036:0.source_cn: 不愧是聪慧过人的夏洛蒂小姐，您记下的细节还真是……全面。

choice_prompt:42:1720824036.text: As expected of the ever-perceptive Lady Charlotte. Your memory for detail is... quite something.
choice_prompt:42:1720824036.source_cn: 不愧是聪慧过人的夏洛蒂小姐，您记下的细节还真是……全面。

say:43:1720824037:0.text: We didn't get much out of it. As we suspected, the mastermind behind it was an old enemy of ours—not the kind to be taken down in a single operation.
say:43:1720824037:0.source_cn: 没什么结果。如我们所料，这起事件背后的幕后黑手就是我们...
say:43:1720824037:0.male: We didn't get much out of it. As we suspected, the mastermind behind it was an old enemy of ours—not the kind to be taken down in a single operation.
say:43:1720824037:0.female: We didn't get much out of it. As we suspected, the mastermind behind it was an old enemy of ours—not the kind to be taken down in a single operation.

say:44:1720824038:1.text: Still... things worked out where it counted. The Jonson family's business was saved.
say:44:1720824038:1.source_cn: 好在这起事件是解决了。他们不想惹麻烦，撤走了人，琼森伯...
say:44:1720824038:1.male: Still... things worked out where it counted. The Jonson family's business was saved.
say:44:1720824038:1.female: Still... things worked out where it counted. The Jonson family's business was saved.

say:45:1720824039:0.text: And everyone lived happily ever after, right?

choice_prompt:46:1720824039.text: And everyone lived happily ever after, right?

say:47:1720824040:0.text: Forget it. He didn't do anything wrong. Given the circumstances, it was the most reasonable choice.
say:47:1720824040:0.source_cn: 算了，他没什么错。形势所迫，在当时，这么做的确是最好的选择。
say:47:1720824040:0.male: Forget it. He didn't do anything wrong. Given the circumstances, it was the most reasonable choice.
say:47:1720824040:0.female: Forget it. He didn't do anything wrong. Given the circumstances, it was the most reasonable choice.

say:48:1720824042:1.text: And besides, he was charming enough back then. Not only did he save my family's business, he also kept me quite entertained.
say:48:1720824042:1.source_cn: 再说，他当时确实讨人欢心，除了救了我家的产业，还给我提...
say:48:1720824042:1.male: And besides, he was charming enough back then. Not only did he save my family's business, he also kept me quite entertained.
say:48:1720824042:1.female: And besides, he was charming enough back then. Not only did he save my family's business, he also kept me quite entertained.

say:49:1720824043:1.text: In any case, I'm now truly getting engaged. He's a good man, and I don't plan to dwell on the past.
say:49:1720824043:1.source_cn: 现在，我也要正式订婚了。对方是个很好的人，我不打算再过...
say:49:1720824043:1.male: In any case, I'm now truly getting engaged. He's a good man, and I don't plan to dwell on the past.
say:49:1720824043:1.female: In any case, I'm now truly getting engaged. He's a good man, and I don't plan to dwell on the past.

say:50:1720824044:1.text: So how about this? Grant me one request, and we'll call it even.
say:50:1720824044:1.source_cn: 这样吧，你答应我一个要求，这一切就算一笔勾销，如何？

say:51:1720824045:0.text: A generous offer, Lady Charlotte... May I ask what this request is?
say:51:1720824045:0.source_cn: 宽容善良的夏洛蒂小姐，可否允许我先问问，这会个是什么样...

say:52:1720824046:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我也不是什么蛮不讲理的人。

say:53:1720824047:0.text: My engagement banquet is tomorrow evening. If you attend, we'll be square. How about it?
say:53:1720824047:0.source_cn: 明天晚上，就是我的订婚宴。你来参加，我们就算两清了。如何？

say:54:1720824048:0.source_cn: 我答应您，我一定会好好考虑的。

say:55:1720824049:1.text: Heh. Take your time. You still have until tomorrow.
say:55:1720824049:1.source_cn: ……呵。无妨，你还有时间慢慢做决定。

say:56:1720824050:1.text: Ansia will send your invitations shortly. Farewell.
say:56:1720824050:1.source_cn: 无论如何，稍后我会让安塞为两位阁下送上请柬。再会。

say:58:1720824041:0.text: I know. Under the circumstances, it really was the best choice.
say:58:1720824041:0.source_cn: 我知道。形势所迫，在当时，这么做的确是最好的选择。
say:58:1720824041:0.male: I know. Under the circumstances, it really was the best choice.
say:58:1720824041:0.female: I know. Under the circumstances, it really was the best choice.

choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 维伦这么做也情有可原……
